flags.reason: The guide (checked 17 October on 0.1.78-a116616, unchanged for Toast on the installed 0.1.78-dbe0e02) has two unclear lines. States says a toast “closes itself after 4 s, or after its own timeout; with no timeout it stays until the screen clears it.”: leaving timeout out gives the 4 s default, so “no timeout” has to mean a timeout of 0 (the playground's Stays); the entry says “a timeout of 0 or less” from the evidence. The Content example “Confirmations” includes “Mobile number is invalid”, an error, beside the guide's rule that a toast confirms something that already happened, and the guide doesn't say whether errors belong in a toast; the entry leaves it out of good copy. Guide fix #530. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-batch9, for Marcin to confirm.

examples.purpose: Copying a UPI ID, the guide's In context: the screen sits in one ToastProvider, which shows toasts at the bottom by default. Copy's onPress calls addToast({ title: 'UPI ID copied' }) (shown as a comment, since addToast is a function, not a component); the toast closes itself after 4 s.
examples.jsx:
<ToastProvider>
  <VStack>
    <Text text="Your UPI ID" />
    <Text text="yourname@jio" />
    <Button
      label="Copy"
      onPress={() => {
        /* addToast({ title: 'UPI ID copied' }) */
      }}
    />
  </VStack>
</ToastProvider>

from.quote: The screen adds it with addToast; it closes itself after 4 s.

props.name: timeout
props.description: Through addToast({ timeout }): how long the toast stays, in ms, from when it is added (default 4000), also for toasts waiting behind the cap. 0 or less keeps it until closeToast or closeAll removes it. Declared: Default 4000, from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: Per toast through addToast({ modes }), or for every toast through the ToastProvider's modes, used for entries without their own. Toast never reads JFSThemeProvider.

props.name: placement
props.description: Set on the ToastProvider (bottom by default, or top), which passes it to every toast it shows; the toast slides in from that edge. Declared: Default "bottom", from the component source.

props.name: startItem
props.description: When `true`, shows the leading icon area (Figma `startItem`). Defaults to `false` so existing call sites stay text-only. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: slotItem
props.description: Optional custom leading content (Figma Slot `slotItem`). Used only when `startItem` is `true`. When omitted, the default `ic_card` icon is shown.

props.name: disableTruncation
props.description: Reachable through addToast({ disableTruncation: true }) since a116616: the title wraps to every line instead of clamping at two. Declared: When `true`, disables text truncation: the trailing ellipsis (`…`) is never shown and any `numberOfLines` clamp is ignored, so the text wraps to as many lines as it needs even when horizontal space is tight.

props.name: autoClose
props.description: When false, the view does not start its own timer. ToastProvider sets this because `addToast` already schedules the close, including for queued toasts. Default true, from the component source.

modes.name: AppearanceBrand
modes.description: Recolours only the leading icon (Light): Primary gold rgb(206,161,90), Secondary rgb(93,0,181), Tertiary rgb(3,107,153). With AppearanceBrand unset, the card icon is Neutral white (#ffffff), as in Figma, not the collection's default Primary gold. Declared: A token collection Toast reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: The surface (dark grey background, white text, faint white border) is the same in every mode. Declared: A token collection Toast reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

slots.name: slotItem
slots.description: Optional custom leading content (Figma Slot `slotItem`). Used only when `startItem` is `true`. When omitted, the default `ic_card` icon is shown.
